description: This Java class 'IntegrationModulesLoader' is a utility for loading and parsing integration module configurations from a JSON file into Java objects. It reads JSON data from a resource file, converts it into 'IntegrationModule' instances, and handles nested configuration details, regions, and module settings.

classes.name: IntegrationModulesLoader
classes.description: A Spring component utility class responsible for loading integration module configurations from JSON files into Java objects, with support for nested configuration structures and regions.

methods.name: loadIntegrationModules
methods.description: Reads a JSON file from classpath, deserializes it into a list of IntegrationModule objects, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: loadModule
methods.description: Parses a Map representing a module configuration, creating and populating an IntegrationModule object with nested details, configuration, and regions.
